Use case: identity-preserve. ONE photographic animation frame, precise local edit.
Image 1 is the HIGH RESOLUTION MASTER and edit target. Keep its exact woman, facial proportions, body build, head scale, camera distance, lighting, black tailored blazer, hip width, slick hair, coral glasses and gold hoops. Image 2 is ONLY a low-resolution reference for the required gesture from the approved first animation. Never copy its blur.
Change ONLY the moving arms/hands/newspaper and the tiny specified head movement to match the gesture in Image 2. The torso and hips behind the paper must remain the exact same size, position, garment shape and pixels as Image 1. No camera movement. Strong temporal continuity with the master is more important than a new aesthetic. Preserve natural high-resolution skin, hair and hand detail.
The same cream newspaper can fold and rotate but its physical dimensions and type sizes never change. Type is printed on one unchanging sheet, so folding hides words rather than reflowing them.
